sentences.text: The evidence provided does not show any pre-payment charge stated in the Key Facts Statement, so the comparison cannot be confirmed from the record provided.
The home loan agreement shows a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding in one in-force version and 3% of the principal outstanding in another in-force version.
Because the Key Facts Statement charge is not shown and the agreement evidence is inconsistent, the record does not support a finding that they state the same pre-payment charge.
